artworks.title: Head of an Old Man
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 24.7 x 19.7 cm (9 3/4 x 7 3/4 in.)
support: 27.2 x 21.5 cm (10 11/16 x 8 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: This image is a charcoal drawing depicting the head and partial shoulders of an elderly man. The man's position is slightly facing the viewer while looking downward. His facial features include deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, and sunken cheeks. His hair is sparse and unkempt, with a receding hairline, and he has a full, untidy beard and mustache. The clothing appears to be simple, though details are indistinct due to the sketch nature of the drawing. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Head of a Man Facing Left [recto]
artworks.medium: black chalk on heavy laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts the head and shoulders of a person in profile view, facing slightly downward. The individual has distinct facial features, including prominent cheekbones, a straight nose, and closed lips, giving the face a defined structure. The person's dark, wavy hair falls to their shoulders and blends into the shaded background. The drawing is monochrome, created with charcoal, showcasing skillful shading to highlight the hair and facial features. There are no visible clothing or accessories. The background is textured with the same shading, emphasizing the facial details and creating a three-dimensional effect.

artworks.title: Study of a Mask
artworks.medium: brown and green wash, heightened with white
artworks.description: The image shows a side profile of a large, sculpted head, filling the frame. The head is angled to the left and has prominent facial features resembling classical or mythological representations. It has a deeply furrowed brow, a wide nose, and an open mouth. The hair is voluminous and merges into a beard. The color palette is primarily earthy tones, giving a weathered, stone-like appearance. The background is softly shaded and indistinct, emphasizing the focus on the facial details.

artworks.title: Head of a Man
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a sketch of an elderly man with thick, wavy hair and a long, flowing beard. His head is slightly tilted downward, with his eyes looking downwards, showcasing deep-set features. The hair seamlessly transitions into the beard, which is depicted with shading for texture. The artwork solely depicts the facial area with no other body parts shown. The background is a light, plain color, and the sketch features delicate, sweeping lines that convey detail and softness in the features. There are no additional objects or jewelry in the sketch, keeping the focus on the facial features.

artworks.title: Head
artworks.description: The image depicts a close-up drawing of a person's head and shoulders, focusing on the upper torso. The subject appears with their head slightly tilted back and eyes closed. The facial features are depicted with a smooth complexion, closed eyelids, and full lips. The wavy hair flows around the head, ending just above the neck. The drawing emphasizes the face and hair, with no clothing, jewelry, or objects visible. The background features sketch-like lines around the head. The artwork is signed and dated 1879 by A. Legros in the top right corner.

artworks.title: Two Studies of Hands
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil sketch of two pairs of hands. One pair is positioned in a prayer-like gesture with interlocked fingers, palms facing inward. The other pair is holding a book, one hand slightly overlapping the pages while the other supports the book from underneath. The hands are detailed and shaded, with no visible facial features or clothing other than cuffs around the wrists. The background is plain, emphasizing the focus on the hands.

artworks.title: Head of an Old Man with a Wide-Brimmed Hat
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a profile portrait of a man. He is facing left, with distinct facial features including a prominent nose, deep-set eyes, and a full beard. He has long hair mostly hidden under a hat. He is wearing a collared garment, possibly a coat or a jacket. The background is textured and monochromatic. No accessories or objects are visible.

artworks.title: Head of a Man Facing Left
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up drawing of a man's head and shoulders viewed from the side, facing left. The man has a long beard, textured hair, aging facial features with deep-set eyes and expressive lines etched into his skin. The drawing style is sketchy with visible pencil or charcoal lines for texture and shading in the hair and beard. He appears to be wearing a simple garment with a visible collar. The background consists of slightly darker strokes emphasizing the form of the man's head without additional objects.

artworks.title: Head of a Bald Man with a Beard
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with yellow and brown wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of an older man. He is facing slightly to the side, with his head turned and his gaze directed upwards. The man has well-defined facial features, including prominent cheekbones, deep-set eyes, and a furrowed brow. His hair is thin and recedes significantly, blending into a full, long beard. The man is wearing what appears to be a robe or a loose garment. The background is textured and monochrome. There are no visible items, jewelry, or objects around him.

artworks.title: At the Foot of the Hill
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed from a slightly elevated angle, as if the observer was standing on a gentle slope. The horizon is positioned low in the composition, with faint outlines of hills or distant landscape elements helping define it, mostly visible on the left side of the piece. The illustration appears to be a drawing or painting using a monochromatic brown wash, especially focusing on loose, flowing brushstrokes and gentle hatching to convey texture and form. Trees dominate the scene, with the closest ones rendered in more solid, darker tones, creating a stark contrast against the lighter distant landforms. There is a textured earth area with rocks close to us, leading into a densely wooded area. The drawing style suggests a careful balance between fluidity and detail, imparting an impressionistic quality to the scene, with a sepia-toned palette giving it an earthy, tranquil character.

artworks.title: In the Marshes
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
image: 26.7 x 49.2 cm (10 1/2 x 19 3/8 in.)
support (sealed mount): 43.1 x 63 cm (16 15/16 x 24 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image is a sepia-toned landscape with a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is towards the middle to lower part of the image, where distant foliage meets the sky. The brushstrokes are fluid and expressive, with a combination of fine lines for details and broader strokes for shadow and form. There is texture and movement in the brushwork, especially in the leafy shapes of the trees. The color palette consists of earthy browns and warm sepia tones. Closest to us are large, dark silhouettes of trees with delicate details. In the distance, the landscape softens towards a cloudy sky at the top.

artworks.title: Head of a Man
artworks.description: The image shows the upper portion of a person's body in a side profile. The head is turned slightly upward and to the side, featuring a strong jawline, prominent cheekbones, and curly hair styled for volume. The person's expression is neutral, and clothing is minimally depicted near the neck. No jewelry or objects are visible. The background is plain, with the artist's signature "A. Legros" at the bottom left.

artworks.title: The Circle of the Falsifiers: Dante and Virgil Covering their Noses because of the st
artworks.description: The image contains intricate lines forming a mountainous landscape. The peaks have abstract, swirling patterns. On the left, a vertical structure resembling a cliff has embedded human figures. Two small mountains dominate the background with sharp, jagged lines. Serpentine shapes are in the foreground. To the right, two tall, robed figures stand on a rock platform. Below are intertwined human figures that appear like a heap on the ground.

artworks.title: The Circle of the Traitors; Dante's Foot Striking Bocca degli Abbate
artworks.description: This is an ink drawing depicting two figures standing on the surface of a frozen lake. Distorted faces can be seen beneath the ice. The background includes a cliff with faces carved into the rock. The artwork conveys dramatic emotion through its composition, lines, and shadows.

artworks.title: Monks in a Cathedral
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash and white heightening over graphite
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 12.9 x 9.4 cm (5 1/16 x 3 11/16 in.)
support: 15 x 11.5 cm (5 7/8 x 4 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows the interior of a grand cathedral or similar structure from an observational perspective. The arches rise above with gothic vaults, while massive pillars define the open central area. Figures in long garments can be seen in the distance, adding scale to the space. The image is in a monochromatic sepia tone, likely ink or wash, giving an antique feel. The shadows and light detail the structure, enhancing its depth and grandeur. The color palette is warm and earthy.

artworks.title: Kneeling, Small (Kniende, klein)
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body sketch of a person in a kneeling position. One leg is bent forward, while the other rests on the ground, supporting their weight. The person has their head slightly tilted with downcast eyes and a serene expression. The hair is short and close to the head. The figure is nude, displaying a posture conveying balance and poise. Both arms are raised above the head, with one hand touching the back of the neck. The background is a simple, textured surface with no distinct elements, keeping the focus on the figure.

artworks.title: Four Women; Three Standing, One Sitting (VierFrauen; drei stehend, eine sitzend)
artworks.description: The image depicts four nude women in various poses. The first woman from the left shows her back and side, with her head turned slightly to the left. The second woman stands with a slouched posture and head tilted downwards. The third woman faces forward with her head inclined slightly downward. The last woman is turned slightly towards the viewer, with her head in profile view to the left. In front of them, a fourth woman is seated with one leg drawn up and her head bowed down. There are no visible garments or accessories. The background is a simple, textured surface resembling a lightly sketched interior.

artworks.title: Woman's Dream (Der Traum des Weibes)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of abstracted forms. It features lines and curves that suggest overlapping organic shapes, creating depth. Cross-hatching and sketch lines add texture to a sparse background. The lines convey a sense of overlapping figures or abstracted silhouettes. The drawing has a subtle and subdued tone, evoking a calm atmosphere.

artworks.title: Three Kneeling Women (Drei Frauen knied)
artworks.description: Three full-body sketches of women kneeling in different poses. The first woman on the left is turned slightly to the left, head bowed with her eyes closed, and arms crossed over her chest. She has long hair that hangs to the side. The second woman in the center faces forward with her head slightly turned to the side, arms crossed over her stomach, and long hair falling loosely. The third woman on the right is turned to the right, with one hand on her head and the other arm slightly bent across her body. Her hair is pulled back, accentuating her face. All figures are nude, and there are no accessories or objects. The background is a textured surface.

artworks.title: Passion II (Leidenschaft II)
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a nude human figure from a foreshortened perspective. The figure is bending at the waist with one knee on the ground and the head turned sideways in a crouching or kneeling pose. The facial features are not detailed, and the head is bald or has closely adhering hair. The outline sketch focuses on the contours of the body without showing clothes or accessories. The background has subtle lines, hinting at movement or variance in the sketch's surface, and remains minimalistic and abstract.

artworks.title: Large Resurrection (Grosse Auferstehung)
artworks.description: The image shows an array of curved lines and shapes forming intertwined figures in an abstract manner. The central figures resemble human forms with elongated limbs and undefined facial features. The lines convey multiple people interacting in an overlapping fashion, surrounded by softer, less defined shapes hinting at additional figures or shadows in the background.

artworks.title: In the Deluged Marsh - The Shepherd (Au marais inonde - Le berger)
artworks.description: The image shows a riverside scene captured from a slight elevation. The horizon is high, featuring distant trees and a softly sketched sky. Two boats, one with a figure steering, are near the viewer. A small flock of sheep is huddled near another boat, and a woman and child stand on the bank. The detailed etching style depicts trees, figures, and landscape with precision. The monochromatic color palette of sepia and black creates a timeless and serene ambiance. In the background, a man heads towards a house surrounded by trees. The composition is serene and balanced, offering a glimpse of peaceful countryside life.

artworks.title: Rue de la Montagne-Sainte-Genevieve, Paris
artworks.description: The image shows a city street scene with a cathedral in the distance. The perspective is from street level, featuring people on the cobblestone path. The cathedral's clocktower is a central point. The buildings on both sides are tall and close together. The style includes intricate etching techniques, fine lines for architectural details, and a sepia color palette. People are depicted moving along the street.
